subject: getting data to Shiny from remote SQL server and ssh tunnelling

messages.author: d7bd49f8c261e5d8
messages.subject: getting data to Shiny from remote SQL server and ssh tunnelling
parts:
I've been playing around with Shiny for a while and I want to be able to use data pulled from a remote SQL sever on it.

Normally when I'm writing local R code, I have to open up a ssh tunnel in Terminal first before I can run

connSettings <- dbConnect(MySQL(),
                          user="username", password="password",
                          dbname="db", host="127.0.0.1", port = 3307) 


If I ever close the Terminal window and try to run the line above, I get this error:

Error in mysqlNewConnection(drv, ...) :
  RS-DBI driver: (Failed to connect to database: Error: Can't connect to MySQL server on '127.0.0.1' (61)
)

My question is: is there any way to get data from this SQL sever into a Shiny App?

Sorry if this is somewhat unclear, not an expert in networks.
